profile_text.body:
IBM is a for-profit public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, trading on a public exchange under the ticker IBM. The company reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing. Its website for the products covered here centers on IBM OpenPages, which the company describes as a highly scalable, AI-powered, unified GRC platform available on any cloud or on-premises, designed to help organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and highlights Citi as a named customer that partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

IBM's tracked AI products span governance, risk, and enterprise AI. IBM OpenPages with Watson is described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance addresses AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and includes EU AI Act accelerators; it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is positioned as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and incorporates capabilities such as agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also notes an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

The held facts indicate IBM has a significant litigation footprint, with 299 cases associated with New York exposure recorded in the site's registry. No MCP server entry is separately listed in the held facts beyond what the product pages describe. IBM's SEC CIK is 0000051143, confirming its status as a reporting public company.
